meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目找出未使用的代码,先验证确认无用,再分批交给多个并行子代理删除,最后运行类型检查、测试和构建,并生成删除报告与提交记录。
howto.when: 当你说“删除死代码”“清理无用代码”等触发词,或要求清理项目时,Claude 会接管执行。如果指定具体文件、目录或符号,则只清理指定范围。

say.text: 请删除这个项目里的死代码
say.note: Claude 会扫描并删除确认无用的代码

say.text: 清理 src 目录下未使用的导出符号
say.note: 只处理 src 目录内的无用导出

say.text: 移除 unusedFunction 这个无用函数
say.note: Claude 会先验证引用再删除

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project for unused code, verifies each candidate, then delegates removal to multiple parallel agents. It finishes with typecheck, tests, build, and produces a removal report with atomic commits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "remove dead code", "cleanup", "remove unused", or ask to clean up the project. If you specify a file, directory, or symbol, the scan is narrowed to that scope.

say_en.text: Remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans and removes confirmed unused code.

say_en.text: Clean up unused exports in src/.
say_en.note: Only handles unused exports in src/.
